generators.carrier: Heisenberg-picture evolution on finite-dimensional lattice algebra
partial trace onto a finite region

relations.statement: For a finite-range local Hamiltonian with interaction strength J, operators A supported on X and B supported on Y satisfy ||[A(t),B]|| <= C ||A|| ||B|| min(|X|,|Y|) exp(-(d(X,Y) - v|t|)/xi) with a Lieb-Robinson velocity v.
relations.hypotheses: Finite local dimension, bounded finite-range interactions, graph metric d; constants C, v and xi depend on J and the interaction range. Not established in the source.

lemmas.statement: A distinction between two states that is detectable by an observable supported on region Y within time t, and that originates in region X, requires d(X,Y) <= v t + xi log(C/epsilon) up to error epsilon.

near_misses.claim: The Lieb-Robinson bound yields a general verdict on quantum computing viability.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The bound only limits the speed of signal propagation. It does not bound error rates or resource overhead, and the source states that no general verdict is justified.

near_misses.claim: The bound holds unchanged for all-to-all or power-law interactions.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Without finite range or sufficiently fast decay of interactions, the linear light cone fails and a different bound is needed.

open_obligations: No source declarations are available to cite, so all references are proposed_new.
The constants C, v and xi are unspecified.
A formal definition of detect, preserve and repair within time t is missing.
A repair model (such as error correction with local recovery) must be tied to the bound.
The conditional statement on quantum computing viability is not derived.
The generators carry no composition licensing relation, so the compositions array is empty.
